}}'''Marco Antei''' (born 1978, [[Sanremo]]) is an [[Italy|Italian]] mathematician and [[LGBT community|LGBT]]+ activist.

== Career ==

Antei was awarded his PhD in mathematics in 2008 from the [[University of Lille]]<ref>Extension de torseurs, PhD Thesis, University of Lille, 2008.</ref> under the supervision of Michel Emsalem. He later worked at the [[Max Planck Institute for Mathematics]] in [[Bonn]], the [[KAIST]] in [[Daejeon]], the [[Ben-Gurion University of the Negev]] in [[Beersheba]], the [[Côte d'Azur University]] in [[Nice]] before joining the [[University of Costa Rica]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://vinv.ucr.ac.cr/sigpro/web/researchers/138000248128 |title = UCR website}}</ref> He has been lecturer at [[Lucerne University of Applied Sciences and Arts]] since 2022. Antei studies within the field of geometry. His areas of interest in research focus on algebraic and arithmetic geometry, and applications. He particularly studies the [[fundamental group scheme]], [[Torsor (algebraic geometry)|torsors]] and their connections.

== The fundamental group scheme ==
The existence of the fundamental group scheme was conjectured by [[Alexander Grothendieck]], while the first proof of its existence is due, for schemes defined over fields, to [[Madhav V. Nori|Madhav Nori]].<ref name=":Nori">{{cite journal | last = Nori | first = Madhav V. | title =On the Representations of the Fundamental Group | journal = Compositio Mathematica | volume = 33 | year = 1976 | issue = 1 | pages = 29–42 | mr = 417179 | url = https://www.numdam.org/item/CM_1976__33_1_29_0.pdf|zbl=0337.14016}}</ref><ref name=":Nori 2">{{cite journal |doi=10.1007/BF02967978|title=The fundamental group-scheme |year=1982 |last1=Nori |first1=Madhav V. |journal=Proceedings Mathematical Sciences |volume=91 |issue=2 |pages=73–122 |s2cid=121156750 }}</ref><ref>{{cite book |doi=10.1017/CBO9780511627064|title=Galois Groups and Fundamental Groups |year=2009 |last1=Szamuely |first1=Tamás |isbn=9780521888509 }}</ref> Antei, Michel Emsalem and Carlo Gasbarri proved the existence of the [[fundamental group scheme#Over a Dedekind scheme|fundamental group scheme]] <math>\pi_1(X,x)</math> for [[Scheme (mathematics)|schemes]] defined over Dedekind schemes and they also defined, and proved the existence of, the ''quasi-finite fundamental group scheme'' <math>\pi^{\text{qf}}(X,x)</math>.<ref name=":Dedekind">{{cite journal |doi=10.46298/epiga.2020.volume4.5436|arxiv=1504.05082|title=Sur l'existence du schéma en groupes fondamental |year=2020 |last1=Antei |first1=Marco |last2=Emsalem |first2=Michel |last3=Gasbarri |first3=Carlo |journal=Épijournal de Géométrie Algébrique |s2cid=227029191 }}</ref><ref>{{cite journal |doi=10.1215/00127094-2020-0065|title=Erratum for "Heights of vector bundles and the fundamental group scheme of a curve" |year=2020 |last1=Antei |first1=Marco |last2=Emsalem |first2=Michel |last3=Gasbarri |first3=Carlo |journal=Duke Mathematical Journal |volume=169 |issue=16 |s2cid=225148904 }}</ref>

== Award ==

In 2020, Antei received the ''Innovating professor'' award at the [[University of Costa Rica]], for being able to move from in presence classes to virtual classes, at the beginning of the [[COVID-19 pandemic]], in the best possible way. The awarded professors have been selected by the students of the [[University of Costa Rica|UCR]].<ref>{{cite web |last=Spagnolo |first=Alice |date=2020-12-10 |title=Imperia, anche al professore Marco Antei un riconoscimento per l'impegno nella didattica a distanza, Riviera24 |url=https://www.riviera24.it/2020/12/imperia-anche-al-professore-marco-antei-un-riconoscimento-per-limpegno-nella-didattica-a-distanza-661878/ |access-date=2025-07-14 |website=riviera24.it}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last=Richmond |first=Karla |date=2020-12-10 |title=Docentes obtuvieron reconocimiento por su labor en virtualidad |url=https://www.ucr.ac.cr/noticias/2020/12/10/docentes-obtuvieron-reconocimiento-por-su-labor-en-virtualidad.html |access-date=2025-07-14 |website=ucr.ac.cr}}</ref>

== Activism ==
Antei stands out for his commitment to the fight for the rights of the LGBT+ community. In particular, in 2015 he conceived and co-founded the first LGBT+ association in the [[province of Imperia]], M.I.A. (''Movimento Imperiese Arcobaleno''), the Arcigay Imperia local committee, affiliated with Italy's largest LGBT+ association, [[Arcigay]]. He served as president until 2018,<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.lastampa.it/imperia-sanremo/2016/05/18/news/unioni-civili-ventimiglia-prontaantei-la-legge-un-passo-avanti-1.35006209/ |title=Unioni civili, Ventimiglia pronta {{!}} Antei: "La legge? Un passo avanti" |website=[[La Stampa]] |date=2016-05-18 |access-date=2024-08-17 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220728031109/https://www.lastampa.it/imperia-sanremo/2016/05/18/news/unioni-civili-ventimiglia-prontaantei-la-legge-un-passo-avanti-1.35006209/ |archive-date=2022-07-28 |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.primocanale.it/archivio-news/160705--stesso-amore-stessi-diritti-incontro-a-imperia-sui-diritti-delle-coppie-omosessuali.html |title="Stesso amore, stessi diritti", incontro a Imperia sui diritti delle coppie omosessuali |website=Primocanale.it |date=2015-09-25 |access-date=2024-08-17 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220725175510/https://www.primocanale.it/archivio-news/160705--stesso-amore-stessi-diritti-incontro-a-imperia-sui-diritti-delle-coppie-omosessuali.html |archive-date=2022-07-25 |url-status=live}}</ref> and then again from January 2023.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.lastampa.it/imperia-sanremo/2023/01/06/news/arcigay_imperia_chiamatemi_la_signora_presidente-12450127/ |title=Arcigay Imperia: "Chiamatemi la Signora Presidente" |last=Borghi |first=Daniela |website=[[La Stampa]] |date=2023-01-06 |access-date=2024-08-17 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230813180132/https://www.lastampa.it/imperia-sanremo/2023/01/06/news/arcigay_imperia_chiamatemi_la_signora_presidente-12450127/ |archive-date=2023-08-13 |url-status=live}}</ref> He definitively left the office in December 2025. During his first term, he also co-organized in November 2016 the first [[Transgender Day of Remembrance]] in the city of [[Sanremo]]. In 2020, he took part in a remote meeting with [[President of the European Commission|European Commission President]] [[Ursula von der Leyen]], in which the rights of LGBT+ people within the [[European Union]] were discussed, with particular emphasis on the situations in Hungary and Poland.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.ilsecoloxix.it/imperia/2020/09/25/news/l-imperiese-antei-di-arcigay-l-unico-italiano-selezionato-a-cui-ha-risposto-a-von-der-leyen-puniremo-le-discriminazioni-1.39349047/ |title=L'imperiese Antei di Arcigay l'unico italiano selezionato a cui ha risposto a Von Der Leyen: «Puniremo le discriminazioni» |website=[[Il Secolo XIX]] |date=2020-09-25 |access-date=2024-08-17 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200929162504/https://www.ilsecoloxix.it/imperia/2020/09/25/news/l-imperiese-antei-di-arcigay-l-unico-italiano-selezionato-a-cui-ha-risposto-a-von-der-leyen-puniremo-le-discriminazioni-1.39349047/amp/ |archive-date=2020-09-29 |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vM1r2fMpUhI |title=Ask the President - Ep1: Questions by Marco |website=YouTube |access-date=2024-08-17 |url-status=live}}</ref> During his final term, the association under his presidency, in collaboration with Agedo Genova, created the ''Premio Queer'', an award unofficially linked to the [[Sanremo Music Festival]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.cosmopolitan.com/it/lifestyle/musica/a63770062/premio-queer-lgbt-sanremo-2025/ |title=Che cos'è il Premio Queer per non dimenticare la comunità LGBT+ a Sanremo 2025 |website=[[Cosmopolitan_(magazine)|Cosmopolitan]] |date=2025-02-12 |access-date=2026-02-20 |url-status=live}}</ref>
